page.notes: The margin at the right holds faint pencil marks and show-through (for example near the top right); these are not printed and are left out. The word after "quorum" is Greek, printed small; I could not read it letter by letter, so the transcription is a best guess and is marked [?]. The first note reads "Cap.I." and the second "Cap.I" as printed; the numeral is uncertain and is not marked further. The page ends mid-word: "nihil-" with the hyphen printed at the line end, and the catchword "omi-" continues it.
